1|"""trimtok delta_engine: cross-turn command snapshot delta (Trimtok 4.0).
2|
3|Repeated commands (pytest, git status, git diff, ...) usually reproduce the
4|same output line-for-line. After the first run is snapshotted per
5|(session, command), a later run whose lines overlap the snapshot by >= the
6|similarity threshold collapses to a delta view:
7|
8|    [tt:delta cmd="pytest -q" sim=100% +#2 -#1 !#1 #c8 #c7]
9|    [tt:legend] Delta vs previous run of the same command: + added, ...
10|    --- STILL FAILING / ACTIVE ERRORS (1) ---
11|    ! FAILED test_1000.py::test_boom - AssertionError: expected 1 got 2
12|    --- ADDED / CHANGED IN THIS TURN (+2) ---
13|    + FAILED test_4000.py::test_new - boom
14|    + ===== 2 failed, 1998 passed in 43.2s =====
15|    --- RESOLVED / REMOVED (-1) ---
16|    - ===== 1 failed, 1999 passed in 42.1s =====
17|
18|Trimtok 4.0 Upgrades:
19|1. Safe Command Family Normalization: Strips cosmetic flags (-v, -q, --tb=...)
20|   while preserving scope/filter flags (-k, test paths).
21|2. Two-Stage Line Alignment: Fast O(N) skeleton overlap (_SLOT_RE) catches
22|   shifted line numbers/durations when exact line overlap drops below threshold.
23|3. Rapidfuzz verification for fuzzy line similarity.
24|4. Fault rail (Priority 1): Recurring errors always emit in STILL FAILING.
25|
26|Never raises.
27|"""
28|
29|from __future__ import annotations
30|
31|import difflib
32|import hashlib
33|import threading
34|from typing import Any
35|
36|try:
37|    from .ccr import put as _ccr_put
38|    from .signals import LEGEND_DELTA, SLOT_RE, delta_head, is_important
39|except (ImportError, ValueError):
40|    from trimtok.ccr import put as _ccr_put
41|    from trimtok.signals import LEGEND_DELTA, SLOT_RE, delta_head, is_important
42|
43|try:
44|    from rapidfuzz.distance import Levenshtein as _Levenshtein
45|    _HAVE_RAPIDFUZZ = True
46|except Exception:
47|    _HAVE_RAPIDFUZZ = False
48|
49|MIN_LINES = 12  # smaller outputs never bother
50|DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 0.65
51|_FUZZY_LINE_SIM_MIN = 0.82
52|_MAX_FUZZY_CANDIDATES = 250
53|_MAX_ADDED = 40
54|_MAX_REMOVED = 15
55|_MAX_STILL = 25
56|_MAX_COMMANDS = 32  # per session
57|_MAX_SNAPSHOT_LINES = 6000  # per command; larger outputs skip delta
58|_MAX_SNAPSHOT_CHARS = 400_000  # per command
59|_MAX_TOTAL_LINES = 24000  # per session
60|_MAX_TOTAL_CHARS = 1_500_000  # per session
61|
62|_COSMETIC_FLAGS = frozenset({
63|    "-v", "-vv", "-vvv", "-q", "-qq", "--verbose", "--quiet",
64|    "-s", "--capture=no", "--capture=tee-sys",
65|    "--tb=short", "--tb=line", "--tb=auto", "--tb=long",
66|    "--color=yes", "--color=no", "--color=auto",
67|    "--no-header", "--no-summary", "--color",
68|})
69|
70|
71|def _normalize_command(command: str) -> str:
72|    """Strip cosmetic/verbosity flags without altering target/filter scope."""
73|    parts = str(command or "").strip().split()
74|    if not parts:
75|        return ""
76|    filtered = [
77|        p for p in parts
78|        if p.lower() not in _COSMETIC_FLAGS
79|        and not p.lower().startswith("--tb=")
80|        and not p.lower().startswith("--color=")
81|    ]
82|    return " ".join(filtered) if filtered else " ".join(parts)
83|
84|
85|def _skeleton(line: str) -> str:
86|    """Normalize volatile numbers, timestamps, and line numbers into {}."""
87|    s = line.strip()
88|    if len(s) < 8:
89|        return s
90|    return SLOT_RE.sub("{}", s)
91|
92|
93|def _line_similarity(a: str, b: str) -> float:
94|    """Stage-2 normalized Levenshtein similarity via rapidfuzz (or difflib fallback)."""
95|    if a == b:
96|        return 1.0
97|    if not a or not b:
98|        return 0.0
99|    if _HAVE_RAPIDFUZZ:
100|        return float(_Levenshtein.normalized_similarity(a, b))
101|    return difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b, autojunk=False).ratio()
102|
103|
104|# Public/internal aliases
105|_cmd_family = _normalize_command
106|_skeleton_line = _skeleton
107|
108|
109|def _digest(text: str) -> str:
110|    try:
111|        return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()[:12]
112|    except Exception:
113|        return ""
114|
115|
116|def _ref_for(text: str) -> str:
117|    """CCR alias for a snapshot; falls back to the raw 12-hex digest."""
118|    try:
119|        ref = _ccr_put(text)
120|        if isinstance(ref, str) and (ref.startswith("#") or len(ref) == 12):
121|            return ref if ref.startswith("#") else f"#{ref}"
122|    except Exception:
123|        pass
124|    d = _digest(text)
125|    return f"#{d}" if d else ""
126|
127|
128|class StatefulDeltaEngine:
129|    def __init__(self) -> None:
130|        # (session, cmd) -> (raw_text, lines, unique_fault_lines)
131|        self._state: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[str, list[str], list[str]]] = {}
132|        self._lock = threading.RLock()
133|
134|    def clear(self, session_id: str = "") -> None:
135|        sid = str(session_id or "")
136|        with self._lock:
137|            if not sid:
138|                self._state.clear()
139|                return
140|            for key in [k for k in self._state if k[0] == sid]:
141|                self._state.pop(key, None)
142|
143|    def _evict(self, sid: str) -> None:
144|        keys = [k for k in self._state if k[0] == sid]
145|        while len(keys) > _MAX_COMMANDS:
146|            self._state.pop(keys.pop(0), None)
147|        if not keys:
148|            return
149|        total_lines = sum(len(v[1]) for k, v in self._state.items() if k[0] == sid)
150|        total_chars = sum(len(v[0]) for k, v in self._state.items() if k[0] == sid)
151|        while keys and (total_lines > _MAX_TOTAL_LINES or total_chars > _MAX_TOTAL_CHARS):
152|            ent = self._state.pop(keys.pop(0), None)
153|            if ent is not None:
154|                total_lines -= len(ent[1])
155|                total_chars -= len(ent[0])
156|
157|    def try_delta(
158|        self,
159|        session_id: str,
160|        command: str,
161|        text: str,
162|        *,
163|        threshold: float = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD,
164|        deadline: Any = None,
165|    ) -> str | None:
166|        """Delta view of `text` vs the previous run of this command, or None."""
167|        try:
168|            if not isinstance(text, str) or not text:
169|                return None
170|            if deadline is not None:
171|                deadline.check()
172|            lines = [ln.rstrip("\r") for ln in text.split("\n")]
173|            if (
174|                len(lines) < MIN_LINES
175|                or len(lines) > _MAX_SNAPSHOT_LINES
176|                or len(text) > _MAX_SNAPSHOT_CHARS
177|            ):
178|                return None
179|            sid = str(session_id or "")
180|            norm_cmd = _normalize_command(command)
181|            key = (sid, norm_cmd)
182|            fault_lines = [ln for ln in dict.fromkeys(lines) if is_important(ln)]
183|            with self._lock:
184|                prev = self._state.pop(key, None)
185|                self._state[key] = (text, lines, fault_lines)  # refresh LRU position
186|                self._evict(sid)
187|            if prev is None:
188|                return None
189|            prev_text, prev_lines, _prev_faults = prev
190|            prev_set = set(prev_lines)
191|            if deadline is not None:
192|                deadline.check()
193|            line_set = set(lines)
194|            overlap = len(line_set & prev_set)
195|            sim = overlap / max(len(line_set), 1)
196|
197|            # Stage 1b: Fast O(N) skeleton match if exact overlap is low
198|            prev_skel = {_skeleton(ln) for ln in prev_lines if len(ln.strip()) >= 8}
199|            line_skel = {_skeleton(ln) for ln in lines if len(ln.strip()) >= 8}
200|            skel_sim = len(line_skel & prev_skel) / max(len(line_skel), 1) if line_skel else 0.0
201|            effective_sim = max(sim, skel_sim)
202|
203|            # Stage 2: Bounded Rapidfuzz Levenshtein verification for mutated lines
204|            fuzzy_matched_cur: set[str] = set()
205|            fuzzy_matched_prev: set[str] = set()
206|            if effective_sim < threshold and len(line_skel) <= _MAX_FUZZY_CANDIDATES and len(prev_skel) <= _MAX_FUZZY_CANDIDATES:
207|                unmatched_cur = [ln for ln in line_set if ln not in prev_set and _skeleton(ln) not in prev_skel and len(ln.strip()) >= 8]
208|                unmatched_prev = [ln for ln in prev_set if ln not in line_set and _skeleton(ln) not in line_skel and len(ln.strip()) >= 8]
209|                for cln in unmatched_cur:
210|                    c_skel = _skeleton(cln)
211|                    for pln in unmatched_prev:
212|                        if abs(len(cln) - len(pln)) <= max(16, len(cln) // 4):
213|                            if _line_similarity(c_skel, _skeleton(pln)) >= _FUZZY_LINE_SIM_MIN:
214|                                fuzzy_matched_cur.add(cln)
215|                                fuzzy_matched_prev.add(pln)
216|                                break
217|                if fuzzy_matched_cur:
218|                    fuzzy_sim = (len(line_skel & prev_skel) + len(fuzzy_matched_cur)) / max(len(line_skel), 1)
219|                    effective_sim = max(effective_sim, fuzzy_sim)
220|
221|            if effective_sim < threshold:
222|                return None
223|
224|            if sim >= threshold:
225|                # Stage 1a: Exact match dominates
226|                added = [ln for ln in lines if ln not in prev_set]
227|                removed = [ln for ln in prev_lines if ln not in line_set]
228|                still = [ln for ln in fault_lines if ln in prev_set]
229|            else:
230|                # Stage 1b / Stage 2: Skeleton & fuzzy line alignment
231|                prev_fault_skels = {_skeleton(ln) for ln in _prev_faults}
232|                still = []
233|                for ln in fault_lines:
234|                    if ln in prev_set or _skeleton(ln) in prev_fault_skels or ln in fuzzy_matched_cur:
235|                        still.append(ln)
236|
237|                added = []
238|                for ln in lines:
239|                    if ln in prev_set or ln in fuzzy_matched_cur:
240|                        continue
241|                    sk = _skeleton(ln)
242|                    if sk not in prev_skel:
243|                        added.append(ln)
244|                    elif is_important(ln) and ln not in still:
245|                        added.append(ln)
246|
247|                removed = [
248|                    ln for ln in prev_lines
249|                    if ln not in line_set and _skeleton(ln) not in line_skel and ln not in fuzzy_matched_prev
250|                ]
251|
252|            prev_ref = _ref_for(prev_text)
253|            cur_ref = _ref_for(text)
254|            body: list[str] = []
255|            if still:
256|                body.append(f"--- STILL FAILING / ACTIVE ERRORS ({len(still)}) ---")
257|                body.extend(f"! {ln}" for ln in still[:_MAX_STILL])
258|                if len(still) > _MAX_STILL:
259|                    body.append(f"  .. (+{len(still) - _MAX_STILL} more in {cur_ref}) ..")
260|            if added:
261|                fault_set = set(fault_lines)
262|                added_disp = sorted(added, key=lambda ln: 0 if ln in fault_set else 1)
263|                body.append(f"--- ADDED / CHANGED IN THIS TURN (+{len(added)}) ---")
264|                body.extend(f"+ {ln}" for ln in added_disp[:_MAX_ADDED])
265|                if len(added) > _MAX_ADDED:
266|                    body.append(f"  .. (+{len(added) - _MAX_ADDED} more in {cur_ref}) ..")
267|            if removed:
268|                body.append(f"--- RESOLVED / REMOVED (-{len(removed)}) ---")
269|                body.extend(f"- {ln}" for ln in removed[:_MAX_REMOVED])
270|                if len(removed) > _MAX_REMOVED:
271|                    body.append(f"  .. (-{len(removed) - _MAX_REMOVED} more in {prev_ref}) ..")
272|            head = delta_head(str(command or ""), effective_sim, len(added), len(removed), len(still), cur_ref, prev_ref)
273|            return "\n".join([head, LEGEND_DELTA] + body)
274|        except Exception:
275|            return None
276|
277|
278|_ENGINE = StatefulDeltaEngine()
279|
280|
281|def try_delta(
282|    session_id: str,
283|    command: str,
284|    text: str,
285|    *,
286|    threshold: float = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD,
287|    deadline: Any = None,
288|) -> str | None:
289|    return _ENGINE.try_delta(session_id, command, text, threshold=threshold, deadline=deadline)
290|
291|
292|def clear_session(session_id: str = "") -> None:
293|    _ENGINE.clear(session_id)
